textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 evs · Water: The Essence of Life · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Most of the Earth's surface is covered with water, but most of it is salty. Only a small amount is freshwater.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Most of the Earth's surface is covered with water, but most of it is salty. Only a small amount is freshwater.
beats.speakEn: Most of the Earth's surface is covered with water, but most of it is salty. Only a small amount is freshwater.

beats.en: Imagine all the water on Earth in one glass. The freshwater would be only as much as a teaspoon! The book shows 5 ml of freshwater beside 200 ml of all water.
beats.speakEn: Imagine all the water on Earth in one glass. The freshwater would be only as much as a teaspoon! The book shows 5 ml of freshwater beside 200 ml of all water.

type: Key Concept: Most of the Earth's surface is covered with water, but most of it is salty.
Rule: Imagine all the water on Earth in one glass.

textbookBox.concept: All living beings, people, animals, birds and plants, depend on freshwater. We need it for drinking, growing crops and our daily activities.

beats.en: All living beings, people, animals, birds and plants, depend on freshwater. We need it for drinking, growing crops and our daily activities.
beats.speakEn: All living beings, people, animals, birds and plants, depend on freshwater. We need it for drinking, growing crops and our daily activities.

beats.en: Many plants and animals also live in freshwater. Without water, life would not be possible.
beats.speakEn: Many plants and animals also live in freshwater. Without water, life would not be possible.

textbookBox.concept: Ocean water is salty, so we cannot drink it. It is useful too. Salt pans of Gujarat dry seawater in flat lands to collect salt; Gujarat is one of the largest salt-producing areas of India.

beats.en: Let us review the key takeaway from Water: The Essence of Life: Ocean water is salty, so we cannot drink it. It is useful too. Salt pans of Gujarat dry seawater in flat lands to collect salt; Gujarat is one of the largest salt-producing areas of India.
